Detailed Description

implements the parts of an icon-list specific to gevas.

generic parts are in icon_list. evas-specific parts are in evas2.

int gevas_bg_update (  icon_list *  il,
int  w,
int  h
) 
 

update canvas-background (play along with pseudo-transparency plugins)

if present, call bg_upd() in the background plugin to let the plugin know the window was moved/resized, the wallpaper was changed, or whatever. plugins that supply pseudo-transparency may then update the PT pixmap for the given evas icon-list. the plug-in may update the background it whatever manner it sees fit.

Parameters:
il the icon-list
w the new width
h the new height
